class.name: MoverRailVehicleBuffCoupl
class.description: [RailVehicleBuffCoupl] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleBuffCoupl].
